name: starship/skeleton
description: Starship Admin application skeleton — Laravel thin shell + System + Generator + admin UI

post-create-project-cmd: @php -r "fwrite(STDOUT, PHP_EOL.'Starship Admin scaffold ready.' . PHP_EOL . 'Next:' . PHP_EOL . '  cd backend' . PHP_EOL . '  composer install' . PHP_EOL . '  copy .env.example .env   # or: cp .env.example .env' . PHP_EOL . '  php artisan key:generate' . PHP_EOL . '  php artisan migrate --seed' . PHP_EOL . '  cd ../apps/admin && pnpm install && pnpm dev' . PHP_EOL . PHP_EOL);"
